description: Structured eval definitions for the Connect Instance Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across the Amazon Connect provisioning surface (contact flow with InvokeLambda block + Lambda resource policy + exceptions handled, routing profile with skill requirements and proficiency levels, Lex V2 IVR integration with published alias and locale match, toll-free phone number claim in matching region, missing-instance-ID prerequisite failure). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Contact flow with InvokeLambda block and exceptions handled
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — InvokeLambda block with FunctionARN for lookup-customer, Lambda.AccessDenied and Lambda.Timeout exceptions handled via transfer to default queue, Lambda resource policy granting connect.amazonaws.com invoke permission explicitly cited
eval_cases.prompt: Create an Amazon Connect contact flow on instance inst-abc123 named "inbound-main-flow". The flow should invoke Lambda function lookup-customer (arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:123456789012:function:lookup-customer) and branch on the returned "department" attribute. Handle Lambda.AccessDenied and Lambda.Timeout exceptions by transferring to the default queue. Instance ARN arn:aws:connect:us-east-1:123456789012:instance/inst-abc123.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CONNECT_INSTANCE: inst-abc123 (my-connect-cc, SAML)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Contact flow: inbound-main-flow (CONTACT_FLOW, all referenced resources verified)
  [✓] Lambda integration: arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:123456789012:function:lookup-customer (resource policy grants connect.amazonaws.com)
  [✓] Exceptions: Lambda.AccessDenied → transfer-default; Lambda.Timeout → transfer-default
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws connect describe-contact-flow --instance-id inst-abc123 --contact-flow-id <flow-id>
  aws lambda get-policy --function-name lookup-customer

eval_cases.name: Routing profile with skill requirements and proficiency levels
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — routing profile with Sales (proficiency ≥ 4) and Support (proficiency ≥ 4) skill requirements, queue associations, VOICE concurrency 1; skill-based routing model explained
eval_cases.prompt: Create a routing profile on instance inst-abc123 named "tier-1-sales-support". Associate queues sales-queue (priority 1) and support-queue (priority 2). Skill requirements: Sales (proficiency ≥ 4), Support (proficiency ≥ 4). Voice channel concurrency 1.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CONNECT_INSTANCE: inst-abc123 (my-connect-cc, SAML)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Routing profile: tier-1-sales-support (sales-queue P1, support-queue P2, VOICE concurrency 1)
  [✓] Skill requirements: Sales (proficiency ≥ 4), Support (proficiency ≥ 4)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws connect describe-routing-profile --instance-id inst-abc123 --routing-profile-id <profile-id>

eval_cases.name: Lex V2 IVR integration with published alias and locale match
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — InvokeAmazonLex block on inbound-main-flow, Lex V2 bot CustomerService alias Prod (published), intent RouteCall, slot department, branch on department to sales-queue or support-queue
eval_cases.prompt: Add a Lex IVR block to the inbound-main-flow on instance inst-abc123. Use Lex V2 bot CustomerService, alias Prod (arn:aws:lex:us-east-1:123456789012:bot-alias/CustomerService:Prod). Intent RouteCall, slot "department". Branch on department value to sales-queue or support-queue.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CONNECT_INSTANCE: inst-abc123 (my-connect-cc, SAML)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Lex bot: arn:aws:lex:us-east-1:123456789012:bot-alias/CustomerService:Prod (V2, published, en_US)
  [✓] IVR: intent RouteCall, slot department, branch to sales-queue / support-queue
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws lexv2-models describe-bot-alias --bot-id <bot-id> --bot-alias-id <alias-id>
  aws connect describe-contact-flow --instance-id inst-abc123 --contact-flow-id <flow-id>

eval_cases.name: Toll-free phone number claim in matching region
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — claim toll-free number +18005551234 for instance inst-abc123 in us-east-1, region matches instance
eval_cases.prompt: Claim the toll-free number +18005551234 for Connect instance inst-abc123 in us-east-1. Description: Main inbound toll-free. Tag Project=inbound.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CONNECT_INSTANCE: inst-abc123 (my-connect-cc, SAML)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Phone number: +18005551234 (toll-free, us-east-1)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws connect describe-phone-number --instance-id inst-abc123 --phone-number-id <phone-number-id>

eval_cases.name: Contact flow request with missing instance ID (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — operator requests a contact flow but no instance ID is provided; flows are children of an instance
eval_cases.prompt: Create a contact flow named inbound-main-flow. The flow should invoke Lambda function lookup-customer. No instance ID is provided. Queues sales-queue and support-queue.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CONNECT_INSTANCE: <missing>
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Instance: no instance ID provided — contact flows require a parent instance
